description.en: Personal WeChat and WeCom (企业微信) for DeepSeek Harness: pair WeChat accounts by scanning a QR code in the Plugins panel, then talk to your agent from WeChat or WeCom with one DSH conversation per contact or group. Text, images, video, documents and archives travel both ways; inbound media is decrypted to $DSH_HOME/wechat-inbox and handed to the model as a path. Sensitive operations can be approved from the chat (reply 1 to allow once, 2 to reject; a timeout falls back to the GUI), and a card lists every chat with Allow / Ignore / Clear plus an optional allowlist. WeCom works three ways: a group-robot webhook, a self-built app, and a two-way intelligent robot over its long connection - messages, images, files and videos both arrive and are sent there, with no public URL needed. Chat commands (/help, /status, /new, /stop) are answered by the bridge itself, without spending a model turn. State persists under $DSH_HOME. No external service, no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的个人微信 + 企业微信桥：在插件面板扫码配对，之后在微信或企业微信里和 agent 对话，每个联系人/群各自一个独立 DSH 会话。文字、图片、视频、文档、压缩包双向互通；收到的媒体解密落盘到 $DSH_HOME/wechat-inbox 并以路径交给模型。敏感操作可在聊天里直接审批（回 1 批准一次、回 2 拒绝，超时自动转回 GUI），卡片面板列出所有联系人与群，可逐条允许/忽略/清除，并可开启「只接收白名单」。企业微信有三条链路：群机器人 webhook、自建应用、以及双向的智能机器人长连接——消息、图片、文件、视频都能收发，且无需公网地址。聊天里支持 /help、/status、/new、/stop 命令，由桥自己直接应答，不消耗模型回合。状态持久化在 $DSH_HOME，重启保留登录。无外部服务、无运行时依赖。
